Kit summary

Flame ThrustBasic
Deals 280% ATK [Burn] DMG to a single enemy.
Duel Saber DanceActive
Cleanses 3 layers of DoT debuffs and 3 layers of Attribute debuffs from every ally. Afterward, deals 3 stages of 180% ATK [Burn] DMG each to a single enemy.
Rose ProtectionPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Max Limit of Resonance Points: 15. When allies gain any [Shield], grants Sotra 1 Resonance Point and each ally can only grant Sotra 1 Resonance Point in this way before Sotra's next turn starts. When Resonance Points reach the max limit, consumes all of them to increase self Turn Meter by 30% and replace Duel Saber Dance with Duel Saber Dance · Resonance; extra Resonance Points cannot be gained until Duel Saber Dance · Resonance is cast. At the beginning of each wave and self turns, grants all allies 1 layer of [Rose Shield] by 300% of Sotra's ATK. The Shield value will be increased to 300% of the original if the Shield is granted to an ally with the [Burn] tag. [Rose Shield]: In the duration, reduces the Direct DMG taken by 40% and cannot gain [Consolidation], up to 3 layers can be owned.
Blade of Rose Lv.1Sotra will pursue and attack a random enemy once when an ally's [Oath of Burn] is consumed. Rose Protection: When Sotra grants Shield for the first time in each wave, she will regard all allies as having the [Burn] tag.
Blade of Rose Lv.3When an ally's [Rose Shield] is broken, Sotra will regrant them 1 layer of [Rose Shield] immediately. This effect can only be triggered once for every 3 turns of an ally.
Suffocating SlashActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies [Oath of Burn] (will be consumed after the owner deals [Burn] DMG and the CD of all the owner's skills will be reduced by 1 turn). Afterward, deals 3 stages of 140% ATK [Burn] DMG each to all enemies. The skill CD cannot be affected or refreshed.
Blade of Rose Lv.2Suffocating Slash: When the skill ends, there is a 100% chance to inflict [Wet II] for 2 turns and a 100% chance to inflict [Cold II] for 2 turns.
Duel Saber Dance · ResonanceActive
Cleanses 3 layers of DoT debuffs and 3 layers of Attribute debuffs from every ally. Afterward, deals 6 stages of 180% ATK [Burn] DMG (considered as Resonance DMG) each to a single enemy, and the DMG dealt to Boss will be increased to 300% of the original.
